# T042 acceptance evidence

Baseline0ddab70(T027), active November6. No architecture/ISA/map/target/clock/reset
priority/CPU/XPR/XDC/image changes. Final task gates pending. Preserve T023 owner
skip/formal NOT RUN. One active task, attended unrestricted runtime, no scheduling,
downloads/install/global changes/push/programming. Baseline source hashes under
evidence/prepare/T042-baseline-2026-11-06.json retain prior files/report prefixes.

Production: uart_rx.sv two-stage ASYNC_REG/single-clock8N1 center sampling;
uart_mmio.sv canonical one-slot receiver and held bus snapshots; uart_mmio_tx.sv
compatibility wrapper preserves old sending interface and old vectors. Internal
meaningful payload10bits with explicit master32-to-[9:0] adaptation; no CPU bus
change. Slotpop at successful selected-low response only if originally valid;
empty response cannot pop later byte. Pop+receive keeps new byte; overrun retains
old; bad stop discards; new errors win W1C. Lane1 controls bits8/9 clears. Disable
aborts partial frame, completed event/pending slot survives; reset clears all.

Independent timestamp/history oracle vs countdownRTL; native pre/post public
outputs and direct receiver, replayable seeds1/20261106, divisors8/7/868. All256
bytes at8, phases0..3ns, production860/876-cycle sender skew, false start/break,
slot/error collisions, long stalls, disable/reset/lanes/errors and duplex traffic.
Three malformed/wrong-byte native negatives plus two actual isolated RTL collision
mutations required. Actual ASYNC_REG2stage/firstfanout/commonclock synthesis check.
Six Python tests PASS after preserved reference-preparation failure/correction:
mid-payload reset release can look like fresh start; deterministic abort now holds
reset through idle. No check/RTL gate relaxed. See docs/UART_RX.md for precise limits.

Native preparation/oldTX replay currently running; no final PASS claimed yet.
Required command python -B scripts/harness.py finish T042 --evidence
evidence/daily/T042.md(at most3). Registry23 retains all22 predecessors; priorTX
test is inside RXgate after shared frontend change. No full23regression/formal/
completeCDC/SoC/IRQ/routedtiming/hardware/ASIC claim. On pass audit current sources,
vectors/summary/WDB/negatives/synth cells, preserve original/report bytes, append
the same two Nov6 reports, reviewdiff/whitespace/staged hashes and commit locally.
Then query actual next dependency-ready task(T028 expected); no daily quota.
